SCOPE: Localize only the visible media approval child controls in packages/dashboard/components/AdaptationControls.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/SavedGenerationRetry.tsx, packages/dashboard/components/RequestedSchedule.tsx and packages/dashboard/components/VideoReview.tsx, plus the existing six-locale catalog contract/tests when keys are required. Use the existing locale provider/catalog/formatter; do not create a second i18n system.
PASS_CRITERIA: 1. Real source changes must be made under COPY_ROOT from exact SOURCE_REF; copied baseline, docs-only, generated output or helper-only change is not delivery. 2. Every new catalog key must be present with intentional translations in en, es, ja, it, pt-BR and de, and the existing locale completeness/type tests must pass. 3. Replace the visible English UI literals in all four named controls: summaries, headings, labels, instructions, safety boundaries, queue/retry/status copy and error copy. Preserve authored adaptation instructions, rationale text, platform/provider identifiers, bundle IDs, scan IDs and API values as data. RequestedSchedule must use the existing selected-locale formatter with an explicit UTC zone instead of raw ISO display. Preserve approval, ToS, idempotency, retry, role and no-publication behavior exactly. 4. Add focused mounted behavior tests covering default English, at least Spanish and Japanese rendering, queued/same-request retry/error states, invalid and valid requested schedules with locale-aware UTC formatting, video-review safety wording and required-field/disabled behavior. Tests must prove authored/provider values remain unchanged data. 5. Run focused component tests, affected core locale/catalog tests, dashboard typecheck, relevant dashboard build, changed-file lint and git diff --check; DELIVERY must report exact commands and real exit codes. 6. DELIVERY must include exact SOURCE_REF, COPY_ROOT, changed repository-relative paths, independently reproducible SHA-256 for every changed file, named behavior tests/counts, command exits, and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE.
BOUNDARY: LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output or files outside COPY_ROOT. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination. Hermes does not commit or push. Codex audits and integrates only a hash-verified terminal delivery.
CORRECTION_BOUNDARY: Codex will audit this lane once. If one named source criterion fails but is locally correctable, Codex may issue one exact correction receipt. If it fails again or the existing locale contract cannot support it, return terminal BLOCKED with the exact conflict. Do not loop on ACKs or unchanged PROGRESS.
Every reply must use the strict FT-HERMES/1 protocol, correlate with the exact WIRE above, include READ_STATUS where required, and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
